samples.title: Giờ làm linh hoạt
samples.prompt: In situations related to flexible working hours, team members may not be available at the same time. What are the causes of this problem, and what could be done to address it?

Đưa giải pháp xử lý đúng nguyên nhân.

samples.summaryVi: Giờ linh hoạt giúp cân bằng trách nhiệm; cần khoảng giờ chung và biết ai đang có mặt.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: Although there may be value in the proposal that employers should offer flexible hours when the work allows it, a practical difficulty is that team members may not be available at the same time. Understanding why this happens is important before suggesting a solution. Otherwise, the same problem may return even after people have spent time and effort trying to improve the situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giới thiệu đúng vấn đề được hỏi.

paragraphs.label: Nguyên nhân
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that flexible schedules may be introduced without agreed shared hours. This can help explain why team members may not be available at the same time. Consider the following situation: a customer question may remain unanswered because the person with the information has already finished work. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nối điều kiện tổ chức với vấn đề.

paragraphs.label: Giải pháp
paragraphs.text: A practical response would be to set core hours and make availability clear to the team. For example, a department could agree that everyone is reachable between ten and three while allowing choice outside that period. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Hành động cụ thể có ví dụ thực hiện.

paragraphs.label: Vì sao giải pháp đáng làm?
paragraphs.text: The aim is not to abandon the useful parts of the idea. It is to make them accessible in practice. For example, a parent can start earlier on two days so that they can collect a child from school. This illustrates the potential value of the fact that employees can organise work around practical personal needs. Asking participants what prevents them from benefiting would help organisers choose changes that actually matter.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, the problem is linked to the fact that flexible schedules may be introduced without agreed shared hours. A practical response is to set core hours and make availability clear to the team. Trying this carefully and listening to the people affected is more convincing than expecting a general instruction to solve the difficulty on its own.

This illustrates the potential value of the fact that employees can share travel costs and reduce the number of separate trips. Asking participants what prevents them from benefiting would help organisers choose changes that actually matter.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đi chung xe giảm chuyến đi riêng và chia chi phí; cần phương án dự phòng khi lịch thay đổi.

A practical response is to agree on practical arrangements and allow flexibility. Trying this carefully and listening to the people affected is more convincing than expecting a general instruction to solve the difficulty on its own.

samples.prompt: In situations related to customer service training, staff may be unable to solve problems without authority. What are the causes of this problem, and what could be done to address it?

samples.summaryVi: Giao tiếp lịch sự cần đi cùng quy trình và quyền xử lý để khách nhận được bước tiếp cụ thể.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: Although there may be value in the proposal that businesses should train staff to handle complaints clearly and respectfully, a practical difficulty is that staff may be unable to solve problems without authority. Understanding why this happens is important before suggesting a solution. Otherwise, the same problem may return even after people have spent time and effort trying to improve the situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giới thiệu đúng vấn đề được hỏi.

paragraphs.label: Nguyên nhân
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that businesses may train communication skills without improving internal procedures. This can help explain why staff may be unable to solve problems without authority. Consider the following situation: an employee may apologise repeatedly but be unable to offer any answer about a delayed refund. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nối điều kiện tổ chức với vấn đề.

paragraphs.label: Giải pháp
paragraphs.text: A practical response would be to give staff clear guidance and a reliable route for difficult cases. For example, a manager could provide a simple decision guide and make sure complex complaints reach the right person. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Hành động cụ thể có ví dụ thực hiện.

paragraphs.label: Vì sao giải pháp đáng làm?
paragraphs.text: The aim is not to abandon the useful parts of the idea. It is to make them accessible in practice. For example, a shop assistant can explain the return process and tell a customer when to expect a response. This illustrates the potential value of the fact that customers can understand what can be done about a problem. Asking participants what prevents them from benefiting would help organisers choose changes that actually matter.
